title: Create: Cleanly Create (Client)
description: It is a minimal vanilla friendly create modpack, with version for both client and server.
body:
# Create: Cleanly Create (Client)

Welcome to a world where brass gears meet grand adventure. **Create: Cleanly Create** is a meticulously curated modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 designed to bridge the gap between complex industrial engineering and immersive RPG exploration. Built on the NeoForge backbone, it offers a seamless experience whether you are tinkering in a workshop or raiding a sprawling fortress.

---

## Key Features

### The Heart of the Machine : Create mod

At the core lies the **Create** mod, supplemented by a suite of expansions to push your contraptions to the limit.

- **Industrial Mastery** : Automate everything with liquid fuels, power loaders, and netherite upgrades.
- **Expanded Logistics** : Utilize package couriers and advanced shuffle filters.
- **New Materials** : Experiment with **Create Oxidized** and **Create Stuff Additions** for unique aesthetic and functional components.

### World Reborn : Exploration and Adventure

The world is no longer a collection of bland hills. With the full **YUNG's Better** suite, every structure has been reimagined.

- **Epic Dungeons** : Traverse vastly improved mineshafts, desert temples, ocean monuments, and nether fortresses.
- **RPG Progression** : Earn unique titles with **Fens MMORPG Titles** and track your glory via custom achievements(DO IT YOURSELF).
- **Enhanced Loot** : Reliable Elytra drops from dragons.

### Visual Splendour and Immersion

Your eyes deserve a treat while you work. The client side is packed with aesthetic enhancements.

- **Polished Graphics** : Includes **ScalableLux** shaders for breathtaking vistas without the frame rate tax.
- **Living World** : **Not Enough Animations**, **Entity Model Features**, and **Entity Texture Features** breathe life into every creature and player movement.
- **Functional Beauty** : A **Create style interface** via **FancyMenu** ensures your menus feel part of the engineering theme.

### Performance First

Engineered for stability, the pack utilizes the latest optimization mods to ensure your laptop stays cool while your factories run hot.

- **Optimized Rendering** : Powered by **Sodium**, **Iris**, **Sodium Extra**, **Reese's Sodium Options**, and **ImmediatelyFast**.
- **Backend Efficiency** : **Ferrite Core**, **Krypton FNP**, **Noisium Forked**, **LazyDFU Reloaded**, and **Dynamic FPS** significantly reduce memory usage and improve frame rates.
- **Smooth Experience** : **Alternate Current**, **BetterFPS**, and **ScalableLux** keep the game running smoothly even with complex contraptions.

---

## Technical Specifications

| Detail                | Specification                             |
| :-------------------- | :---------------------------------------- |
| **Pack Name**         | Create: Cleanly Create(Client)            |
| **Version**           | 1.0.0                                     |
| **Minecraft Version** | 1.21.1                                    |
| **Mod Loader**        | NeoForge 21.1.219                         |
| **Primary Focus**     | Automation / Exploration / RPG            |
| **Control Scheme**    | Enhanced via **Controlling** and **Jade** |

### Client-Side Features

- **Integrated Shaders** : ScalableLux shaders pre-configured for optimal performance.
- **Minimap Support** : Navigate your world with **Xaero's Minimap** and **Xaero's World Map**.
- **Inventory Tweaks** : Streamlined item management with **Inventory Tweaks Refoxed** and **JEI**.
- **Visual Enhancements** : Full suite of animations (**Not Enough Animations**, **Entity Model Features**, **Entity Texture Features**, **Entity Culling**) and graphical improvements (**Continuity**, **FancyMenu**, **Just Zoom**).
- **Quality of Life** : **AppleSkin**, **Clumps**, **Bookshelf**, **Cloth Config**, **Jade**, **Controlling**, **Easy Shulker Boxes**, and **Freecam** for a smoother experience.
- **Audio** : **Simple Voice Chat**, **Melody**, and **Music Player** for immersive sound.
- **Optimization** : **Sodium**, **Iris**, **Sodium Extra**, **Reese's Sodium Options**, **ImmediatelyFast**, **Dynamic FPS**, **CreateBetterFPS**, and **ScalableLux**.

---

## Installation

1. Download the `.mrpack` file: `Create: Cleanly Create(Client)-1.0.0.mrpack`
2. Import into your preferred modpack launcher (Prism Launcher, Modrinth App, etc.)
3. Launch and enjoy!
